name: delivery
description: Pull-request landing with merge proof and receipts, receipt-driven worktree cleanup, delivery agents and fan-out instructions for OpenCode V2.

agent-plugins.description: Pull-request landing with merge proof and receipts, receipt-driven worktree cleanup, delivery agents and fan-out instructions for OpenCode V2.
agent-plugins.discrepancies: pi (and OMP, which loads the pi bundle) gets only an explicit delivery_cleanup for the session's repository: no delivery_land, automatic cleanup or clone registry.

prerequisites.for: delivery_cleanup's worktree, ref and remote proofs, git worktree remove and git branch -d
delivery_cleanup's pull-request read (gh pr view) for a GitHub receipt
delivery_cleanup's merge-request read (glab mr view) for a GitLab receipt
delivery_cleanup's read-only bd show of a receipt's beads when the repository's Beads ledger is active
